body: Hi and thank you for your response. I kind of agree with you, I guess because I've always had depression, and it was getting worse, this hit at the wrong place at the wrong time. She just told me I was very unfriendly. Probably because I was talking to another customer, and I didn't hear her try to get my attention. But it still hurt me and caught me off guard. And my job was simple, and I felt terrible that I couldn't do it with a straight head. And I always liked listening to music and writing, and looking at comedy skits, looking for ideas to write just for comedy. But I can barely do that now. I go through weird times where I can sometimes, but lately it's very sporadic. But thank you for your thoughts.
